description.zh:
待转加密的密文。  
该参数可以为对称加密或非对称加密返回的密文数据。  

- 对称加密：调用[Encrypt](~~28949~~)、[GenerateDataKey](~~28948~~)、[GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext](~~134043~~)或[GenerateAndExportDataKey](~~176804~~)接口返回的密文数据。  

- 非对称加密：可以是调用[GenerateAndExportDataKey](~~176804~~)接口返回的公钥加密数据，也可以是外部系统使用非对称公钥加密的数据。
description.en:
The ciphertext that you want to re-encrypt.
This parameter can be the ciphertext that is returned after symmetric or asymmetric key encryption.

- Symmetric encryption: the ciphertext that is returned after you call the [Encrypt](~~28949~~), [GenerateDataKey](~~28948~~), [GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext](~~134043~~), or [GenerateAndExportDataKey](~~176804~~) operation. - Asymmetric key encryption: the data that is encrypted using a public key after you call the [GenerateAndExportDataKey](~~176804~~) operation, or the data that is encrypted using an asymmetric public key in an external system.

description.zh: key/value的JSON字符串，用于目标主密钥加密时的加密上下文。
description.en: A JSON string that consists of key-value pairs. This parameter specifies the encryption context for the destination master key.

description.zh: 对密文解密后再次加密时使用的对称主密钥ID。
description.en: The ID of the symmetric master key that is used to re-encrypt the data after the ciphertext is decrypted.

description.zh:
是否开启DryRun模式。

- true：开启
- false（默认值）：关闭

DryRun模式用于测试API调用，验证您是否具有相应资源的权限，以及请求参数是否配置正确。DryRun模式开启后，KMS会始终返回失败并提示失败原因。失败原因包含如下：

- DryRunOperationError：不配置DryRun参数时，请求会成功。
- ValidationError：请求中指定的参数有误。
- AccessDeniedError：您无权在KMS资源上执行该操作。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the DryRun mode.

- true: enables the DryRun mode.

- false (default): disables the DryRun mode.

The DryRun mode is used to test API calls, verify whether you have the permissions to perform operations on the required resources, and check whether the request parameters are valid. If you enable the DryRun mode, KMS always returns a failure and a reason for the failure. The reasons for the failure include the following:

- DryRunOperationError: The request would have succeeded if the DryRun parameter was not configured.

- ValidationError: The parameters specified in the request are invalid.

- AccessDeniedError: You are not authorized to perform the operation on the KMS resource.

description.zh:
CiphertextBlob是公钥加密结果时，指定公钥加密的算法。算法详情，请参见[AsymmetricDecrypt](~~148130~~)。    
取值：

- RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256
- RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1
- SM2PKE  
  

> 当CiphertextBlob是非对称加密返回的公钥加密数据时需要指定该参数。
description.en:
If CiphertextBlob is the result of public key encryption, specify the public key encryption algorithm. For more information about the algorithms, see [AsymmetricDecrypt](~~148130~~).
Valid values:

- RSAES\_OAEP\_SHA\_256 - RSAES\_OAEP\_SHA\_1 - SM2PKE > You must specify this parameter when CiphertextBlob is the data that is encrypted using a public key after asymmetric key encryption.

description.zh:
key/value的JSON字符串。如果在[Encrypt](~~28949~~)、[GenerateDataKey](~~28948~~)、[GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext](~~134043~~)或[GenerateAndExportDataKey](~~176804~~) API中指定了该参数，则需要提供同样的参数才能解密，详情请参见[EncryptionContext说明](~~42975~~)。  
> 当CiphertextBlob是对称加密返回的密文数据时需要指定该参数。
description.en:
A JSON string that consists of key-value pairs. If you specify this parameter when you call the [Encrypt](~~28949~~), [GenerateDataKey](~~28948~~), [GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext](~~134043~~), or [GenerateAndExportDataKey](~~176804~~) operation, you must specify the same parameter to decrypt the data. For more information, see [EncryptionContext](~~42975~~).

> You must specify this parameter when CiphertextBlob is the ciphertext that is returned after symmetric encryption.

description.zh:
解密密文时使用的主密钥ID。  
主密钥的全局唯一标识符。  

> 当CiphertextBlob是非对称加密返回的公钥加密数据时需要指定该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the master key that is used to decrypt the ciphertext.
The globally unique identifier of the master key.

> You must specify this parameter when CiphertextBlob is the data that is encrypted using a public key after asymmetric key encryption.

description.zh:
用于解密密文的密钥版本标识符。  
> 当CiphertextBlob是非对称加密返回的公钥加密数据时需要指定该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the key version that is used to decrypt the ciphertext.

> You must specify this parameter when CiphertextBlob is the data that is encrypted using a public key after asymmetric key encryption.

descriptions.zh:
### 注意事项

- RAM用户或RAM角色调用该OpenAPI需要被授予的权限策略详情，请参见[访问控制](~~2767210~~)。

- 本接口仅支持通过共享网关调用，不支持通过专属网关调用。详细介绍，请参见[阿里云SDK](~~601559~~)。

  通过共享网关调用即通过公网、VPC域名访问KMS，该方式需要打开公网开关。具体操作，请参见[通过公网访问KMS实例中的密钥](~~2856718~~)。



### QPS限制
仅支持通过共享网关调用，本接口的单用户QPS限制为750次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。

### 详细说明
ReEncrypt使用场景如下：

- 主密钥（CMK）进行轮转后，使用轮转后最新的密钥版本对数据进行重新加密。自动轮转密钥详情，请参见[自动轮转密钥](~~134270~~)。

- 主密钥不变，改变加密上下文的内容，进行重新加密。

- 将主密钥加密的数据或者数据密钥在KMS内部使用其它的主密钥进行重新加密。


ReEncrypt权限设置如下：

- 需要有操作源主密钥的kms:ReEncryptFrom权限。
- 需要有操作目的主密钥的kms:ReEncryptTo权限。
- 可以设置kms:ReEncrypt*用于表示上述两个操作的权限。
descriptions.en:
### Notes

- For more information about the access policy required to grant a RAM user or RAM role the permission to use this operation, see [Resource Access Management](~~2767210~~).

- This operation is accessible only through a shared gateway, not a dedicated gateway. For more information, see [Alibaba Cloud SDK](~~601559~~).

  When using a shared gateway, you access KMS through an Internet or a VPC domain name. This method requires Internet access to be enabled. For more information, see [Access keys in a KMS instance over the Internet](~~2856718~~).

### QPS limits

This operation is accessible only through a shared gateway. The single-user queries per second (QPS) limit is 750. If this limit is exceeded, requests are throttled, which may affect your business. We recommend that you stay within the specified limit.

### Details

You can use the ReEncrypt operation in the following scenarios:

- After a customer master key (CMK) is rotated, you can use the latest key version to re-encrypt data. For more information about automatic key rotation, see [Automatic key rotation](~~134270~~).

- You can re-encrypt data by changing the encryption context without changing the master key.

- You can re-encrypt data or a data key that is encrypted by one master key with another master key in KMS.

The ReEncrypt operation requires the following permissions:

- The kms:ReEncryptFrom permission for the source master key.

- The kms:ReEncryptTo permission for the destination master key.

- You can use kms:ReEncrypt\* to grant both permissions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob ODZhOWVmZDktM2QxNi00ODk0LWJkNGYtMWZjNDNmM2YyYWJmS7FmDBBQ0BkKsQrtRnidtPwirmDcS0ZuJCU41xxAAWk4Z8qsADfbV0b+i6kQmlvj79dJdGOvtX69Uycs901q00000000 --source-key-id 5c438b18-05be-40ad-b6c2-3be6752c0000 --source-key-version-id 2ab1a983-7072-4bbc-a582-584b5bd80000 --source-encryption-algorithm RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256 --source-encryption-context Example=Example --destination-key-id 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-123456780000 --destination-encryption-context Example=Example --dry-run false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun kms ReEncrypt --region cn-hangzhou --DestinationKeyId '1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-123456780000' --SourceKeyId '5c438b18-05be-40ad-b6c2-3be6752c0000' --SourceEncryptionAlgorithm RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256 --SourceEncryptionContext '{"Example":"Example"}' --DestinationEncryptionContext '{"Example":"Example"}' --CiphertextBlob 'ODZhOWVmZDktM2QxNi00ODk0LWJkNGYtMWZjNDNmM2YyYWJmS7FmDBBQ0BkKsQrtRnidtPwirmDcS0ZuJCU41xxAAWk4Z8qsADfbV0b+i6kQmlvj79dJdGOvtX69Uycs901q00000000' --SourceKeyVersionId '2ab1a983-7072-4bbc-a582-584b5bd80000' --DryRun false
